summary: Applied both spec-review blocking findings by specifying test-review coverage/header structured data and flow-level repair ownership.

items.title: Test-review header precheck has no specified structured data path
items.rationale: Specified test-coverage.json validation.ok/messages as the structured non-semantic signal and allowed equivalent structured origin/failureKind fields for generated header findings.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R4], acceptance_criteria[R4], overview.data_flow, overview.decisions, clarifications, and task T-1 now name the structured coverage/header signal.

items.title: Test-review repair loop ownership is ambiguous
items.rationale: Specified flow-level repair between separate review invocations, with each semantic FAIL consuming the existing reviewRetry budget and no command-internal auto-fix loop.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R5], acceptance_criteria[R5], overview.data_flow, clarifications, implementationTargets, and task T-4 now define ownership and budget consumption.
